scope: Local authorized write admission; not a claim that remote policy changes are atomic with browser storage.
decision: Pass one access guard through all protected command persistence, load/CAS loops and real DraftStore save. Recheck after asynchronous boundaries, immediately before put and in last put success event; synchronously call commit while guard valid. Only actual complete means saved. Abort before admission on scope/session invalidation. A revocation after explicit commit admission cannot undo a committing transaction; retain the already authorized original ACK and hide UI. Safe cancellation does not use the subject guard.
not_changed: original command IDs and request bodies
